##### Project general facts

Reportage Tower at Lagos is a high-rise apartment development with light-coloured framing, grey façade sections, warm vertical accents and projecting balconies. Stepped wings rise above a curved podium, bringing private homes, shared leisure spaces and service facilities together within a single building.

Shared facilities include an infinity pool, gymnasium, children’s play area and a jogging track within the parking area. Retail outlets, childcare facilities and meeting spaces support daily routines, while a reception lobby, concierge-style services, housekeeping and round-the-clock security provide additional support.

The homes offer studios and one-bedroom, two-bedroom and three-bedroom layouts. Kitchens or kitchenettes connect with living areas, while separate bedrooms, balconies and utility rooms vary by unit type. Interior features include kitchen cabinets, countertops, built-in wardrobes, double-glazed windows, central air conditioning and tiled bathrooms with showers, vanity units and mirrors.

##### Parking

Shared parking at ground level and within the podium.

##### Location description and benefits

Victoria Island is an established part of Lagos, combining residential streets with shopping and dining destinations. Local shops support everyday errands, while healthcare facilities, including Reddington Hospital, provide medical services within the district. Cafés and restaurants offer places for dining and social gatherings.

The lagoon gives the area a waterfront setting, while Muri Okunola Park provides green space for walks and outdoor recreation. Terra Kulture’s art gallery and performance venues broaden the district’s leisure options with exhibitions and theatre, contributing to the city’s cultural life.

Ozumba Mbadiwe Avenue and Ahmadu Bello Road support movement through Victoria Island. Falomo connections and the Lekki–Epe Expressway link the district with other parts of Lagos, while the wider road network provides access to the mainland and Murtala Muhammed International Airport.
